list.title: Configs
list.tooLarge: There are too many configs, or they are too large, to load in one go. Delete the ones you no longer need and try again.
list.cap: Showing the first 500 of {{total, number}}. Narrow the search to see the rest.
list.inUseBy_one: In use by {{count, number}} service. Open it to see what uses it.
list.inUseBy_other: In use by {{count, number}} services. Open it to see what uses it.

delete.label: Delete config {{name}}
delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: This deletes the config and its content.
delete.inUse: {{name}} is still in use. Remove it from the services that use it, then try again.

errors.generic: Something went wrong on the server. Try again, and check the Bayplan logs if it keeps happening.
errors.permission: You no longer have permission to do that. Your access may have changed.
errors.hostReadOnly: This host is read-only. Changes are turned off on the host itself, so Bayplan can only read from it.
errors.noManager: No manager node is connected right now. Try again when one is back.
errors.notASwarm: This environment isn't a swarm, so it has no configs.

error.loadFailed: Couldn't load {{name}}. Docker may be unreachable. Try again.

gone.heading: This config is gone
gone.body: It was removed, or a new version replaced it. Go back to the list to find it.

inUse.title: {{name}} is in use
inUse.body: Services that mention it count, even with no running tasks. Remove it from them first.

content.title: Content
content.binary: This config isn't text, so it can't be shown here. Download it to look at it.

inspect.loadFailed: Couldn't load the inspect output of {{name}}.
